summary: Frontend-only validation of two DiagramCanvas bug fixes (text truncation + Chaos risk flagging). Ran a full audit against default gpt-4o-mini with an e-commerce requirements prompt. All three columns (architect, chaos, hardened) loaded successfully. Verified via DOM inspection: no ellipsis anywhere, node text renders fully (wraps to lines), Chaos column has 1 node flagged with amber border + '!' badge, Architect has 0 flagged nodes, connector SVG paths render (4/2/6), and no horizontal overflow beyond column bounds.

issues: LLM occasionally produces a very sparse chaos diagram (only 2 nodes, e.g. Primary -> DB). Fix works but diagram quality depends on model output.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In hardened mode the LLM sometimes emits '!' prefixes that cause DiagramCanvas to attach data-testid='column-hardened-diagram-flagged-node' to nodes even though no '!' badge is rendered (badge is chaos-only). Consider only setting node.flagged when mode==='chaos', or stripping '!' before flagged detection in non-chaos modes, to keep test-ids semantically clean.
critical_code_review_comments: DiagramCanvas: flagged detection runs regardless of mode; only the badge is gated by mode==='chaos'. This causes flagged-node test-ids to appear in hardened column too. Low impact, cosmetic/testability concern only.

Clipped-node heuristic detected a 6px scrollWidth vs clientWidth delta on the flagged '!Primary' node — caused by the absolute-positioned '!' badge extending slightly beyond the box; not a text-truncation issue (text is fully readable).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both diagram bugs verified fixed. Use testid 'column-chaos-diagram-flagged-node' to assert chaos flagging. Note hardened column may also have flagged-node testids due to LLM '!' prefixes leaking — this is not a rendering bug (no badge shown) but could be tightened by main agent if desired.
rca of the issue: Original: (1) label text used text-overflow ellipsis + max-width truncated to a small pixel budget → 'Da ta b…'; (2) chaos mode had no way to mark risky node. Fixes verified: text now wraps (whiteSpace:normal, wordBreak:break-word, no line-clamp); parseDiagram detects '!'-prefix flag from LLM (backed by CHAOS_SYS prompt update + MOCK_ATTACK_DIAGRAM '!API Server'/'!Primary DB') with a fallback that flags deepest node when LLM omits; amber border + tinted bg + boxShadow ring + top-right '!' badge only in chaos mode.
